Azure Government note: what-if parameters are Gov-ready — they run entirely inside the model with no external service dependency.

How this was built:
1. 'Margin Adjustment %' is a calculated table created with GENERATESERIES(-0.1, 0.2, 0.01), giving a slider from -10% to 20% in 1% steps.
2. 'Selected Margin Adjustment %' reads the slider value with SELECTEDVALUE, defaulting to 0%.
3. 'Adjusted Gross Margin %' = base Gross Margin % + the selected adjustment.
4. 'Adjusted Gross Margin' reapplies that adjusted percentage to Sales Amount.
5. 'Adjusted Margin vs Base' shows the dollar swing versus the unadjusted Gross Margin measure.

Tasks: 1) Move the slider below and watch the Adjusted card and chart respond. 2) Compare the Base and Adjusted cards side by side. 3) Explain in your own words why the adjustment is additive to the margin percentage rather than the dollar amount.
